answer: Sybil farms profit by amortization: one scripted answer cloned across a dune of fake identities while the operator tends a single lotus of real work. Break that with adversarial peer examination. Before challenge rewards settle, each identity must defend its own submitted answer live against a randomly assigned examiner, in an exchange of unscripted follow-up questions no template can precompute. A cloned fleet cracks here: the farm either pays genuine inference per identity, erasing its margin, or its defenses come back incoherent and the flag falls, the walnut of profit turning to ash.
